summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting total voting rights as of 31 July 2026 under UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The filing states issued share capital of 154,032,064 ordinary shares, with 5,431,782 held in treasury, yielding 148,600,282 voting rights. It notes share buybacks since 1 July 2026 were treated as cancelled, executed under shareholder authority from the 7 May 2026 AGM and instructions announced 17 February 2026. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of voting capital, not a special-situation event; no transaction, offer, or strategic action is involved.
